0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat are opening their 2026-27 seasons, and this is the Timberwolves' first game of the year. For Minnesota, Donte DiVincenzo is out following Achilles surgery, while Anthony Edwards, Ayo Dosunmu, Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga, LaMelo Ball, Rocco Zikarsky, Rudy Gobert, and Trey Lyles are listed as day-to-day. For Miami, Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest), and Pelle Larsson (illness) are all listed as day-to-day. Minnesota won its 2025-26 season series against Miami 2-0, most recently beating the Heat 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance to win.
